task: EPMCDME-15515: agent dispatch rows in the CLI analytics session Timeline report only their own subagent's cost and tokens, through an exact agentId chain (Agent hook event -> llm_request agent_id -> api_request group), with the parent-span fallback restricted to dispatches without an agentId.

component_scope.label: S
component_scope.affected: CLI analytics PostgreSQL reader (session dispatch query) and its SQL-shape and live test suites

requirements_clarity.label: M
requirements_clarity.gaps: The ticket fixed the goal but not the attribution source; the fallback rule for a known agentId without api_request events needed an owner decision (CR-001).

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Three approaches were needed (even split, time windows, ID chain); the chain spans three tables and parses agentId from tool_response; fallback rules can silently leak main-thread cost; live tests skip without a reachable database and one passed by accident
technical_risk.mitigation: Live tests seeded like real telemetry and run red first; query verified over all real sessions in the local analytics DB and against the API for session 52d226aa

key_reasoning.reason: The attribution source was not obvious: two approaches were tried and replaced before the agentId chain, and the fallback rule needed a review round to stop main-thread cost leaking onto subagents
All production changes are in one SQL query in one repository file; the handler and the response model are unchanged for cost
